narration: Take a vocabulary of fifty thousand tokens. That is roughly typical in scale, not exact.
caption: मान लीजिए पचास हज़ार टोकन की शब्द-सूची। यह मोटा अंदाज़ा है।
image_brief: A wall of card catalogue drawers filling the frame, dozens of small labelled drawers, one drawer slightly ajar showing tightly packed cards, dim archive light.

narration: Now the prompt. My phone battery drains fastest when the screen is... and it stops there.
caption: सवाल: मेरे फ़ोन की बैटरी सबसे तेज़ तब घटती है जब स्क्रीन...
image_brief: A printed line of text ending mid-sentence on white paper, the remaining half of the line left empty, a phone lying face down beside it, soft morning light.

narration: The model scores all fifty thousand options for that one empty slot. All of them.
caption: मॉडल उस एक ख़ाली जगह के लिए पूरे पचास हज़ार विकल्पों को अंक देता है।
image_brief: A vast scoreboard of narrow slots covering a wall, each slot holding a small numbered card, one slot near the centre lit brighter than the rest, cool hall light.

narration: Say bright lands at forty one percent. On at twenty two. Dim at nine.
caption: मान लीजिए: ब्राइट 41 प्रतिशत, ऑन 22 प्रतिशत, डिम 9 प्रतिशत।
image_brief: Three horizontal bars drawn in chalk on a slate board, clearly different lengths, a short word written at the start of each bar, warm lamp light from above.

narration: The rest split what remains. Mostly fractions of one percent. Thousands of near-zero candidates.
caption: बाक़ी विकल्प बची हुई जगह बाँटते हैं, वह भी एक प्रतिशत से कम।
image_brief: A dense field of extremely short chalk tick marks along the bottom edge of a slate board, so faint they nearly vanish, one bold bar far above them, side light.

narration: Pick bright. Append it. Now the entire computation restarts with bright already inside the sentence.
caption: ब्राइट चुनो, जोड़ो। अब पूरा हिसाब उसी शब्द के साथ फिर से शुरू।
image_brief: A printed sentence now complete, its final word set in slightly darker ink, a fresh empty box ruled after it, pencil shavings scattered nearby, plain light.

narration: Notice what actually happened. The surrounding sentence constrained that answer almost completely, on its own.
caption: ध्यान दीजिए: आसपास के शब्दों ने ही जवाब को लगभग तय कर दिया।
image_brief: A narrow paper funnel standing upright on a table, its mouth wide at the top, a single small bead resting at the narrow base, soft light from one side.

narration: Grammar allowed an adjective there. The topic allowed only a handful of sensible adjectives.
caption: व्याकरण ने विशेषण की जगह दी, और विषय ने गिने-चुने विशेषण छोड़े।
image_brief: A wooden shape-sorter board with one triangular hole and only three matching triangular blocks left beside it, other blocks pushed far aside, warm nursery light.

narration: Now change one word. My phone battery drains fastest when the temperature is... and stop.
caption: अब एक शब्द बदलिए: ...जब तापमान... और वहीं रुक जाइए।
image_brief: The same printed prompt line with one word covered by a pasted paper patch carrying a different word, the patch edge visible, the line ending mid-air, desk light.

narration: The shortlist changes completely. High. Low. Above. Below. Bright has fallen off it entirely.
caption: सूची पूरी तरह बदल जाती है: हाई, लो, ऊपर, नीचे। ब्राइट बाहर।
image_brief: A slate board wiped half clean, four new short words written in a fresh column with new bars, a smudged ghost of the old column still faintly visible, low light.

narration: Nothing was looked up in either case. The surrounding words did all the steering.
caption: दोनों बार कुछ भी खोजा नहीं गया। आसपास के शब्दों ने ही दिशा दी।
image_brief: A closed reference book pressed shut with a rubber band on a shelf, thick dust along its top edge, a bare reading table in front of it, faint window light.

narration: That is your lever, and the most useful thing here. Hold onto it until the end.
caption: यही आपका असली ज़ोर है। इसे आख़िर तक याद रखिए।
image_brief: A long steel lever resting in a slotted floor bracket, its handle polished bright from use, the surrounding concrete floor plain and empty, hard side light.

narration: Now the dangerous version. Ask that phone battery's exact capacity, in a single sentence.
caption: अब ख़तरनाक हाल: उसी बैटरी की ठीक-ठीक क्षमता पूछ लीजिए।
image_brief: A phone lying on its back on a workbench beside a small blank specification label and a pair of tweezers, no printing on the label at all, cool bench light.

narration: The pattern demands a number in that slot. Something has to go there. Blank is impossible.
caption: ढाँचा उस जगह एक आंकड़ा माँगता है। ख़ाली छोड़ना मुमकिन नहीं।
image_brief: A printed certificate with every line completed except one numeric field, that field showing a bold empty ruled box, an ink pad waiting beside it, plain light.

narration: So it produces one. Four thousand five hundred milliamp hours. Round, plausible, immediately convincing.
caption: तो वह एक आंकड़ा गढ़ देता है: 4500 एमएएच। सुनने में पूरा सही।
image_brief: A crisp printed number on a small white card propped against a matte black block, the card edges sharp, no logo or source printed anywhere, soft studio light.
